brief: Two bases side by side joined with side connectors, each with a bin.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full, adjacent cells on level 0.
connector:0#0,0|1,0 (side-connector-single) bridges the shared edge between the two bases. A double side connector was also available; I used the single one.
bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, one plain full bin per base.

finish.summary: Built two adjacent bases joined by a single side connector, each holding a full bin. Also ran house rules: capOpenFaces added 10 end caps on open faces and lockJoints added a joint bolt, which cleared the LOOSE_BODY warning. check_build is clean with meshClash clear. No props were added since the brief concerns structure only.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-single  (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-single (cut 9 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
